title: Notion vs Obsidian for personal knowledge management
meta_description: Notion vs Obsidian for people choosing a personal knowledge management system: documented workflows, constraints, and a source-backed decision summary.
intro: This source-backed comparison addresses the observed query pattern “Notion vs Obsidian personal knowledge management” for people choosing a personal knowledge management system. It compares stable, documented workflows and constraints rather than volatile prices, inventory, ratings, or reviews.
verdict: Choose Notion when a shared workspace with connected pages and databases matches the work. Choose Obsidian when local Markdown files and a customizable vault are the priority. Validate sharing, sync, export, backup, and organization needs before committing a knowledge base.
